# Toggle

Figma: `Toggle`, node `4634:77833` (page Components, `1:28`).
2 variants - `state[2]` - plus a boolean `icon` property that is not a variant axis.

## Markup

State lives on `aria-checked`, not on a modifier class, so the accessible state and the
visual state cannot drift apart.

```html
<button type="button" class="v27-toggle" role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-label="Notifications">
  <span class="v27-toggle__knob">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden="true"><!-- cross --></svg>
  </span>
</button>
```

Set `aria-checked="true"` to turn it on; the CSS follows. The glyph is optional - Figma's
`icon` property - and is a tick when on, a cross when off.

## Classes

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.v27-toggle` | the track, 39x20 |
| `.v27-toggle__knob` | the 16px knob |

## Values

| Property | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| track | 39x20, 2px padding, 13px radius | `4634:77832` / `4634:77831` |
| track, off | `Border/input` | bound |
| track, on | `Foreground/Positive` | bound - see below |
| knob | 16px, 17px radius, raw white | `4634:80745` |

Both radii are off the Radius scale (4/8/16); they are Figma's values for a pill and a
circle, so both are literals.

Two things to know:

- The on state fills the track with **`Foreground/Positive`** - a text role used as a
  surface, the only place in the library that happens. Retokenising that text colour would
  silently restyle this switch. FINDINGS.md #21.
- The knob is a raw white, not `Background/Primary`, so it stays white in dark mode.

## All classes in this component

`.v27-toggle`, `.v27-toggle__knob`
